provenance: Original mathematical sine oscillator/envelope synthesis for Michael Dicker. No voices, human imitation, sampled inputs, downloads, external audio or copied melodies. numpy is a calculation tool only.
user_direction: 2026-11-06: replace sharp repeated finger-interaction beep with long curious/enjoyable ooOOooo-like electronic sound.

integration.trigger: once when a drag/petting gesture is recognized, not pointerdown or each move event
integration.repeat_policy: no automatic loop; at most once per contact for initial implementation
integration.interruption: fade current cue over 100-150 ms on release/cancel, mute, visibility loss or higher-priority face reaction; cancel pending cues
integration.runtime_gain: start at unity on app copy; do not normalize sustained cue up to sharp-beep peak
integration.preserve: remembered mute, initial-gesture audio unlocking, original short-tap chirp and unrelated reaction sounds

loudness_note: Target active RMS -21 dBFS, quieter than short reaction chirps. Numeric balance is a starting point, not phone/perceived-loudness proof.
